title: Function-specific Givens Views over a shared SAE feature vector
hypothesis: On four held-out relation tasks in pinned Pythia-70m, one shared 16-feature SAE code plus eight task-specific Givens angles will preserve explicit-FV causal quality within .10 gold-logprob nats and .05 accuracy, use <=0.50x explicit-FV incremental bytes, and beat both an equal-code-size pairwise-gain control and global OMP-16 by >=.10 gold-logprob nats in both development seeds.
physical_object: Pinned Pythia-70m plus pretrained tied 2048-atom layer-3 SAE and one shared 16-value feature vector over a fit-selected atom pool.
mirror_coordinate: Eight angles per task rotate four fixed pairs of the shared 16-dimensional SAE feature vector using block-diagonal 2D Givens matrices.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen relation-task residual interventions generated from one shared SAE feature vector and small task-specific angle codes; tasks 12-15 are withheld from pool/shared-vector fitting.

artifacts.tasks: Reuse MA-516 task sets, support splits, layer-4 FVs and causal evaluator.

task.primary_metric: mean held-out gold candidate log probability
secondary_metrics: actual code and full deployment bytes

view.pool_selection: Top sixteen aggregate positive SAE encoder activations across task FVs 0-11; deterministic stable sort.
view.shared_vector: One learned FP32 c in R16; decoder atoms are the selected tied-SAE encoder rows.
view.mirror_code: For task t, apply four Givens rotations to fixed pairs (0,1),(2,3),(4,5),(6,7) and (8,9),(10,11),(12,13),(14,15), with one FP32 angle per pair. Decode W_pool^T Q(m_t)c.
view.fit: Jointly minimize vector MSE for c and angle codes on tasks 0-11; Adam full-batch, lr=.01, exactly 2000 updates, zero weight decay.
view.heldout_compile: Hold c and pool fixed; fit only eight angles per held-out task to its offline FV target with Adam lr=.01 for exactly 500 updates. Teacher vectors are discarded from inference state.

controls: Equal-size native pairwise gain control: one independent gain per Givens pair and task
Global signed OMP-16 over all 2048 SAE atoms

fresh.opening_rule: Only if both seeds pass causal-quality and byte gates and beat equal-size native gains and global OMP-16 by >=.10 nats.

paid_objects: full SAE artifact for standalone deployment
explicit FV bank and native-control coefficients
storage.accounting: Report incremental codes on a preloaded SAE system and standalone Pythia+SAE+View total, versus Pythia+explicit FVs. No decoded residual vectors are cached.

compute.optimizer_updates: 2000 shared fit plus 4x500 heldout angle assignment per seed
compute.active_compute_proxy: report SAE activation/pool selection, angle fitting over 16-dimensional decoder, and transformer query sequences separately

gates.PASS: Both seeds: within .05 accuracy/.10 gold-logprob nats of explicit FVs, code payload <=0.50x explicit FV bank, and >=.10 gold-logprob nats better than both equal-size pairwise gains and global OMP-16.
gates.FAIL: Any frozen causal, byte, or native-control gate is missed.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Artifact hash, split integrity, or deterministic replay fails.

boundaries: One pretrained 4x SAE and four held-out relation tasks; not broad steering evidence.
Full SAE bytes are charged to standalone deployment.
Givens views must be compared to ordinary pairwise gains and native sparse coding.
Fresh seeds stay sealed unless every gate passes.
